title: Field-aware invert of a prior overwrite-mode MoveClips command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip overwrite-mode MoveClips of a left remnant onto a right remnant restores only that command's overwrite write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert restores the moving remnant's start, restores the carved destination's start and duration, rebinds the leftover carved cue to clipLocal, restores the followed moving cue, and keeps the later markers and the unmoved stay cue. A later text edit of the leftover carved cue, or of the followed moving cue, also does not conflict; invert keeps the new text.

A later leave-gap out-trim of the carved destination remnant, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP, and does not officialize insert-mode MoveClips invert, includeLinks=false invert, overwrite PasteClips invert, or auto-close of a vacated source gap. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered RippleDeleteClips, RippleTrimClip, leave-gap TrimClip, leave-gap DeleteClip, MoveClip / MoveClips, LiftClips/Cut, SplitClip, ExtractAudioClip, UnlinkAudioVideo / LinkAudioVideo, SetAudioTrackState, and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH. An overwrite that would uncover or crop a source cue remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. An overwrite that would overlap a followed cue and a dest remnant remains CAPTION_OVERLAP. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and is not used on this path.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds hello, carved, and stay cues, sets collision mode to overwrite, multi-selects the left remnant, previews and commits a +1s overwrite MoveClips, adds a later marker, inverts the MoveClips command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The native multi-move ghost of a caption-bearing timeline also refuses that policy, but that refusal does not block committing the pending gesture. Extract is not required. Official later work is a marker or a text edit, not a later dest trim.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, leave-gap delete, move, lift/cut, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip / rightmost RippleDeleteClips / leave-gap DeleteClip / leave-gap MoveClip / LiftClips / reject-mode MoveClips, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND.
